instructions: Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Question 1 refers to Passage A01. On the day after his first success, how many times did the young elephant repeat his solution within one session?
items.evidence: About two minutes after an unreachable branch was hung up, Kandula rolled the cube into place and stood on it, and he repeated the trick nine times within a single session.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says that the next day Kandula rolled the cube into place and stood on it, repeating this solution nine times within a single session; the answer is therefore 'nine times'.

items.prompt: Question 2 refers to Passage A02. From which stretch of water were the animals used in the experiment taken?
items.evidence: The researchers collected sixty octopuses from the Bay of Naples over two summer seasons and formed twenty-four pairs, each matched so that the two animals differed in weight by no more than fifteen per cent.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says that sixty octopuses were collected from the Bay of Naples over two summer seasons; since the question asks where the animals were taken from, the answer is 'Bay of Naples'.

items.prompt: Question 3 refers to Passage A03. According to the passage, how long do laboratory studies of this slow global process normally last?
items.evidence: Predicting the long-term effects of this slow global process is difficult in a laboratory, where experiments typically run for only weeks or months.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that laboratory experiments typically run for only weeks or months; the answer is therefore 'weeks or months'.

items.prompt: Question 4 refers to Passage A04. In the observing run that revealed the moon, how many long-exposure images did the camera capture?
items.evidence: On 2 February 2025, Webb's Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images, each lasting forty minutes, over a period of roughly six hours, tracking a faint point of light moving against the background of stars in a pattern consistent with an object orbiting Uranus itself.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images on the observing run of 2 February 2025; the answer is therefore 'ten'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Question 4 refers to Passage A04. On what date did the earlier spacecraft mission make its close approach to Uranus?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: NASA's Voyager 2 spacecraft flew past Uranus on 24 January 1986, capturing the only close-up images of the planet's moons that exist to this day, and yet it did not detect this moon at all.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi bir dunya bilgisi: Voyager 2'nin Uranus'e en yakin gecis tarihi (24 Ocak 1986) halka acik NASA kayitlarindan bilinen unlu bir tarih; model uc turda da gun/ay/yil dogru yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Soru kokunun tamami zaten 'o tarih neydi' sorusudur, yani eksen dunya bilgisinin kendisi. E6 onerisi: F/2'nin ikinci yarisi - Voyager'in cektigi yakin goruntulerin bugun hala tek ornek olmasi, ya da bu uydunun o gecise hic yakalanmamis olmasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru F/2'ye capaliydi ve cevabin kendisi (24 Ocak 1986) NASA kayitlarindan bilinen unlu bir tarihti. Yeni soru F paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit B/2'ye, gozlem dizisindeki poz sayisina tasindi. E5'in onerdigi iki secenek de ayni cumlenin ikinci yarisiydi ve ikisinin de cevabi 'Voyager 2' olurdu, yani ayni dunya bilgisi kalirdi; bu yuzden yuva bastan baska bir paragrafa tasindi. Poz sayisi tek bir gozlem programina ozgu, disaridan turetilemeyen bir ayrinti. Ayni cumlenin oteki iki olcusu (poz basina kirk dakika, toplam alti saat) AC2 akis semasi 1 ve practice cumle tamamlama 10'da kullanildigi icin bu yuvaya poz sayisi birakildi.

items.prompt: Question 5 refers to Passage A05. Roughly how old was the burnt grain that the team tried to recover genetic material from?
items.evidence: An international research team set out to change that by attempting to extract and read ancient DNA directly from the charred grains, roughly 8,400 years old.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that the team tried to extract DNA from charred grains roughly 8,400 years old; the answer is therefore '8,400 years'.

items.prompt: Question 6 refers to Passage A06. Besides Japan itself, in how many countries were the company's staff based?
items.evidence: Its roughly 900 employees, spread across all 47 of Japan's prefectures and 23 other countries as of March 2025, handle client work entirely through remote communication platforms.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says the company's employees are spread across all 47 of Japan's prefectures and 23 other countries; since the question asks how many countries besides Japan, the answer is '23'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Question 6 refers to Passage A06. Which idea do the researchers draw on to explain how a well-established team knows which member to turn to?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The researchers interpret the pattern through the idea of a transactive memory system, in which effective teams develop a shared, largely implicit sense of who knows what, letting members find the right person to ask rather than needing constant interaction.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Model parcasiz uc turda da 'transactive memory' verdi, yani cevabin ayirt edici iki sozcugunu birebir tutturdu; dusen tek sey genel 'system' basiydi. Sorunun ekseni bir kurami ADIYLA sormak ('researchers hangi fikre dayaniyor'), o kuram da orgut psikolojisinin en cok atif yapilan kavramlarindan biri: 'kim neyi biliyor' ortak bellegi transaktif bellek diye adlandirilir. Bu yuzden sorun kip ya da konum degil eksenin kendisi -- kanit cumlesi ne kadar yeniden yazilirsa yazilsin, alani bilen cozucu adi metne bakmadan veriyor. E6 onerisi: H paragrafinin olcusel iddialari -- Caster'in yalniz bireysel ciktiya gore odeme yapmasi, ya da deneyimli meslektasin faydasinin daha AZ duzenli kesintiyle artmasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru H/1'e capaliydi ve bir kurami adiyla soruyordu; kuramin adi orgut psikolojisinin ders kitabi bilgisi oldugu icin cevap pasajsiz cikiyordu. Yeni soru H paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit A/2'ye, sirketin calistigi ulke sayisina tasindi ve cevap bir kavram degil, disaridan bilinemeyecek bir sayi. E5'in onerdigi iki olcusel iddia (yalniz bireysel cikti uzerinden odeme, daha az kesintiyle artan fayda) bu adimda kullanilamadi, cunku ikisi de H/2'ye capali ve o cumle practice not tamamlama 3 ile AC2 coktan secmeli 34-35'te zaten kullanilmis durumda. A/2'nin oteki sayisi olan 47 vilayet E5 tarafindan tam da genel kultur oldugu icin elenmisti; bu yuzden soru ulke sayisina soruluyor ve kok 'Japonya disinda' diyerek 'other' ayrimini korumayi zorunlu kiliyor.

items.prompt: Question 7 refers to Passage A07. In total, how many sessions were the four whales involved in?
items.evidence: Between February and November 2001 the animals took part in 98 separate sessions split into two phases.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says that the animals took part in 98 separate sessions split into two phases between February and November 2001; the answer is therefore '98'.

items.prompt: Question 8 refers to Passage A08. Which date's radar image did the analysts use as their pre-earthquake baseline?
items.evidence: By comparing an image captured on 8 December, only two days after the earthquake, with a baseline image from 26 November, before the quake, analysts could see large new patches of brightness spreading across slopes that had previously appeared smooth and dark, a direct signature of freshly broken rock and snow.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the post-earthquake image of 8 December was compared with a baseline image from 26 November, taken before the quake; the answer is therefore '26 November'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Question 8 refers to Passage A08. Which summit does the passage identify as the highest in Canada?
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The most conspicuous single event showed up as a wide cascade of debris pouring down the flank of Mount King George, while further landslide scars were visible around Mount Logan, Canada's tallest peak.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi bir dunya bilgisi ve soru kokunun tamami onu soruyor: 'Kanada'nin en yuksek zirvesi' sorusunun cevabi Mount Logan'dir ve model uc turda da yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Kokten 'highest in Canada' ibaresini cikarmak soruyu duzeltmez, baska bir soru yazmak olur - talimatin yarim duzeltme saydigi sey budur. E6 onerisi: D/1'in oteki yarisi - Mount King George'un yamacindaki genis enkaz akmasi ya da uydu goruntusuyle yer arastirmasinin ortusmesi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru D/1'e capaliydi ve cevap Kanada'nin en yuksek zirvesi olarak bilinen bir cografya gercegiydi. Yeni soru D paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit C/3'e, karsilastirmada kullanilan deprem oncesi temel goruntunun tarihine tasindi. E5'in onerdigi iki secenek de D/1'in yarilariydi; ama Mount King George'un yamacindaki enkaz akmasi AC3 ozellik eslestirme 24'te, 12 Aralik'taki yer arastirmasi ise practice not tamamlama 8 ile practice coktan secmeli 11'de zaten kullanilmis durumda, bu yuzden yuva bos duran C paragrafina tasindi. 26 Kasim keyfi bir gecis tarihi, disaridan turetilemez; ayni cumlenin 8 Aralik yarisi AC3 cumle tamamlama 21'de kullanildigi icin bu yuvaya temel goruntunun tarihi birakildi.

items.prompt: Question 9 refers to Passage A09. Which technique revealed the fine inner structure of the glass-like substance at very high magnification?
items.evidence: Scanning electron microscopy allowed them to visualise the fine internal structure of the glassy material at extremely high magnification, while energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy measured its chemical composition.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says that the fine internal structure of the glassy material was visualised with scanning electron microscopy, while its chemical composition was measured with a separate technique; the answer is therefore 'scanning electron microscopy'.

items.prompt: Question 10 refers to Passage A12. What did everyone in the second study complete before the last recall test, so that drowsiness would not affect their scores?
items.evidence: To reduce the grogginess that can follow a nap and distort test performance, all participants completed a 30-minute puzzle game before their final recall test.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says that to prevent drowsiness from affecting test performance, all participants completed a 30-minute puzzle game before the final recall test; the answer is therefore '30-minute puzzle game'.
